description: Insert up to 32 project items in one validated CEP request. All items and target tracks are preflighted before the first insertion; every requested placement is read back, and the tool fails closed if Premiere cannot verify one.

clips.description: Ordered placements. They use the same insert-edit semantics as add_to_timeline; later placements must not share a target video-track start time.

audio_track_index.description: Audio target for linked source audio (defaults to 0).

item_id.description: Project item node ID or unique name.

start_seconds.description: Timeline insertion time in seconds (defaults to 0).

name: add_to_timeline_batch

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Add To Timeline Batch
